parameters.help_en: The ID of the notes agent. Specify the ID of a published recording notes agent
parameters.help_zh: 小记智能体ID，需传入已上线的录音小记智能体ID
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The storage path of the recording file in OSS. Use the FilePath returned by the upload address retrieval operation
parameters.help_zh: 录音文件在 OSS 中的存储路径，需使用获取上传地址接口返回的 FilePath
parameters.name: file_path

parameters.help_en: The custom task ID defined by the business side. This ID is used to associate external business records during callbacks or troubleshooting
parameters.help_zh: 业务方自定义任务ID，用于回执或问题排查时关联外部业务记录
parameters.name: biz_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the LLM model used for notes inference. If this parameter is not specified, the default model configuration of the agent is used
parameters.help_zh: 小记推理使用的 LLM 模型 ID。不传时使用智能体默认模型配置
parameters.name: llm_model_id

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The detailed reason why access is denied
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝的详细原因

Data.description_en: The recording notes task ID returned after successful submission. This value corresponds to the CallId in the subsequent asynchronous notes result callback
Data.description_zh: 提交成功后返回的录音小记任务 ID，即后续异步小记结果回执中的 CallId

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call is successful
